title: Conscious acts act back on local neural activity

statements.text: Emergence runs both ways: global order parameters constrain the components that sustain them. If conscious cognitive acts are emergent processes of brain, body and environment, they can have causal effects on local neuronal activity, and this reciprocal causation is an empirical and experimental question.

sources.quote: it seems legitimate to conjecture that downward causation occurs at multiple levels in these systems, including that of conscious cognitive acts in relation to local neural activity
the issue of downward causation is not only philosophical (see Box 1) but empirical and experimental
